About this connector
Salesforce is the world’s #1 customer relationship management (CRM) platform designed to help businesses find more prospects, close more deals, and provide customers with outstanding service. Onna connects directly with the Salesforce Lightning API to collect files hosted within Lightning Enterprise accounts.
With Onna + Salesforce connector, you can:
Connect out-of-the-box
Leverage a no-code, simple UI that helps you get started quickly and easily without needing IT resources.
Customize to your needs
Perform case-specific collections, auto-sync, and archive Salesforce data.
Work faster
Use federated search to surface specific content in Salesforce files. 
Capture content
Collect historical information and related metadata, including: file name, file ID, author, file creation and last modified date, file size, and extension.
